summary.done: Scaffold verified and completed: index.html + js/main.js (fixed 60Hz accumulator loop, 960x540 logical space, dpr-aware fit-to-viewport 16:9 letterbox, single GAME_SCALE knob) plus placeholder systems/update.js and systems/render.js drawing a moving test box. Made GAME_SCALE runtime-tunable via setGameScale() (exported + window.setGameScale for console/debug), since ESM export let bindings are read-only. Verified headlessly with node: modules parse and load without errors, rAF loop runs stable over 30 frames, resize re-fits live preserving 16:9, backing store scales with devicePixelRatio, transform maps 960x540 -> backing store correctly, GAME_SCALE=2 uniformly upscales with no distortion.
summary.decisions: Kept existing scaffold structure (main.js owns loop+fit, systems/ holds update/render). Exposed setGameScale on window so it can be tuned from browser console or the future F1 debug harness. Canvas centered via CSS absolute translate(-50%,-50%) so letterbox bars are just page background.
summary.lessons_learned: ESM 'export let' bindings cannot be reassigned from outside the module — need an accessor function for any externally tunable knob. Headless DOM-stub smoke tests (node --input-type=module with stubbed document/window/requestAnimationFrame) give solid verification of loop + scaling math without a browser. .plan-progress.json did not exist; initialized it from .plan.json (all 23 tasks pending) before writing the summary.
summary.tradeoffs: GAME_SCALE is module-level mutable state behind an accessor rather than a plain exported const — the price of making the knob runtime-tunable while keeping ESM bindings immutable. Test box uses wall-clock time for motion (visual only); real entities will use accumulated sim time in later tasks.
